uncovered_shapes.sentence: According to the investigation, as O Globo reports it, the group also hid trafficking proceeds through split transfers, cash withdrawals, and pass-throughs to third parties and to newly opened companies with no real economic activity.

claims.claim: Anses November benefits rise 1.93 percent, matching September inflation of 1.9 percent as published by Indec, using two decimal places.
claims.episode_span: a September inflation reading of 1.9 percent, as Indec published it, becomes a 1.93 percent adjustment
claims.supporting_quote: De esta manera, los jubilados y pensionados tienen un reajuste del 1,93% , en concordancia con la inflación registrada en septiembre, que fue del 1,9% .

claims.claim: The November minimum pension is 444,158.45 pesos plus a 70,000-peso bonus for a total of 514,158.45 pesos, and the maximum is 2,988,765.84 pesos with no bonus.
claims.episode_span: the minimum pension stands at 444,158.45 pesos

claims.claim: The November universal pension is 355,326.76 pesos plus 70,000 pesos, and the non-contributory disability or old-age pension is 310,910.91 pesos plus 70,000 pesos.
claims.episode_span: The Universal Pension for Older Adults is 355,326.76 pesos plus the same 70,000-peso bonus

claims.claim: The extraordinary pension bonus has remained 70,000 pesos, frozen since March 2024, and for benefits above the minimum it is paid proportionally up to a cap of 514,158.45 pesos.
claims.episode_span: the bonus figure has not changed and has stayed frozen since March 2024
claims.supporting_quote: El bono extraordinario sigue siendo de $70.000 , cifra que no percibe cambios y se mantiene congelada desde marzo de 2024.

claims.claim: Tens of thousands protested in Colombia’s main cities against De la Espriella without major incidents, despite hail and the president’s threat of a hard line.
claims.episode_span: tens of thousands of people protested in Colombia’s main cities
claims.source_title: La izquierda colombiana muestra su músculo en sus primeras marchas contra De la Espriella
claims.supporting_quote: Decenas de miles de personas protestan sin incidentes importantes en las principales ciudades del país pese al granizo y a la amenaza de mano dura del presidente

claims.claim: More than 30 people held by police in Jalisco after the October 11 Guadalajara clean-water march have been released, but many legal cases remain open, and the account says they were kettled and beaten.
claims.episode_span: more than 30 people held by police in Jalisco have been released
claims.supporting_quote: Las más de 30 personas retenidas por la policía en Jalisco han sido liberadas, pero muchos de los procesos legales en su contra no se han cerrado.

claims.claim: São Paulo prosecutors and federal police are serving 14 temporary arrest warrants and 15 search warrants over about 120 suspicious parcels, and three people were arrested.
claims.episode_span: Authorities are executing 14 temporary arrest warrants and 15 search-and-seizure warrants
claims.source_title: Operação da PF em SP prende suspeitos de enviar drogas escondidas em eletrodomésticos
claims.supporting_quote: Ao todo, são cumpridos 14 mandados de prisão temporária e 15 de busca e apreensão na capital paulista, em São Caetano do Sul e Praia Grande, além de Palhoça (SC), Foz do Iguaçu e Pinhais (PR). Três pessoas foram presas.

claims.claim: The Centro Cultural General San Martín, by Mario Roberto Álvarez, opened on May 8, 1970, and occupies more than 42,000 square meters including six basements for 900 people.
claims.episode_span: It opened on May 8, 1970. It occupies more than 42,000 square meters
claims.supporting_quote: El complejo, una obra del arquitecto Mario Roberto Álvarez , abrió sus puertas el 8 de mayo de 1970 y ocupa más de 42.000 metros cuadrados distribuidos en una torre administrativa, un edificio principal de salas teatrales y seis subsuelos con capacidad para 900 personas.

claims.claim: The BBC reports Brazil’s Congress approved a shorter working week and that Lula’s supporters hope it boosts his popularity ahead of a runoff in 10 days.
claims.episode_span: Brazil’s Congress has approved a shorter working week
claims.source_title: Brazil's Congress approves shorter working week in win for Lula
claims.supporting_quote: Lula's supporters hope the measure will boost his popularity ahead of a presidential run-off in 10 days.

claims.claim: Gendarmerie found six choique eggs under a car seat at kilometer 1812 of Route 3 near Comodoro Rivadavia.
claims.episode_span: found six choique eggs, also called the Patagonian rhea, under a front passenger seat
claims.source_title: Miden 13 cm y pesan casi un kilo: Gendarmería recuperó seis huevos de ñandú
claims.supporting_quote: el procedimiento fue realizado por integrantes del Escuadrón 41 “Comodoro Rivadavia” a la altura del kilómetro 1812.

claims.claim: Two Cuban scientists produced Chile’s first cloned horse and said cloning humans would not be complicated and that the limitation is ethical.
claims.episode_span: two Cuban scientists, who began their careers in Havana some years after the Dolly the sheep milestone, have produced Chile’s first identical copy of a horse
claims.source_title: Los investigadores que lograron el primer caballo clonado en Chile
claims.supporting_quote: Dos científicos cubanos, que empezaron su carrera en La Habana unos años después del hito de la oveja Dolly, logran la primera copia idéntica en el país de un equino

claims.claim: In Rio’s first round, Flávio Bolsonaro took 79.67 percent of valid votes in section 581 at Rosa da Fonseca school, and Lula took 78.74 percent in section 309 at Colégio Angelorum.
claims.episode_span: Flávio Bolsonaro’s best city result was 79.67 percent of valid votes in section 581
claims.source_title: Os endereços em que Flávio e Lula tiveram suas maiores votações na cidade do Rio
claims.supporting_quote: No caso do bolsonarista, o melhor resultado foi na Escola Municipal Rosa da Fonseca, na Vila Militar. A seção 581 deu 79,67% dos votos válidos ao filho de Jair. Já Lula recebeu 78,74% na seção 309 do Colégio Angelorum, na Glória.

claims.claim: Newmark found Rio high-end office vacancy at 23.5 percent in the third quarter of 2026, the lowest since 2014, with net absorption of 17,000 square meters and asking rent of 83.43 reais per square meter.
claims.episode_span: vacancy in Rio de Janeiro’s high-standard corporate offices, classes AAA, AA, and A, fell to 23.5 percent
claims.source_title: Mercado de escritórios de alto padrão no RJ registra menor vacância desde 2014
claims.supporting_quote: Um levantamento inédito da Newmark aponta que a vacância dos imóveis classe AAA, AA e A caiu para 23,5% no terceiro trimestre de 2026 — o menor nível desde 2014.
